name: Sarltooth's Talon
summary: Above Whelgar's Excavation Site, Sarltooth's Talon marks the end of the raptor's attack. Ormer Ironbraid wants the claw as proof that the beast has been slain.

sections.title: A Trophy of Vengeance
sections.body: Ormer Ironbraid watched from the ridge as raptors overran Whelgar's Excavation Site and butchered the dwarven expedition. He could not stop the slaughter. One massive raptor, Sarltooth, seemed to Ormer the likely pack leader. Seeking vengeance for his fallen kin, Ormer demanded the beast's death and one of its talons as proof. The claw marks the end of Sarltooth's reign over the ancient dwarven ruins.

faq.q: Where does Sarltooth's Talon come from?
faq.answer: Sarltooth's Talon comes from Sarltooth, a large alpha raptor prowling the western ridges above Whelgar's Excavation Site in the Wetlands.
Ormer Ironbraid wants the talon. The dwarf is stationed on the overlook above Whelgar's Excavation Site and asks for proof that the beast that slaughtered his crew has been slain.

faq.q: Why does Ormer Ironbraid need proof of Sarltooth's death?
faq.answer: Ormer believes Sarltooth led the raptor pack that drove off and killed the dwarven excavators. He sees the talon as justice and closure for his fallen colleagues.

faq.q: What happened to the dwarves at the excavation site?
aliases: why are raptors at the dig
faq.answer: The dwarven dig sought ancient artifacts for the Explorers' League. Wild raptors ambushed the workers, slaughtering most and driving the survivors to the nearby ridge.

angles.text: As a dwarf, recovering this talon brings vengeance for the dwarven archaeologists who died serving the Explorers' League at King Magni Bronzebeard's behest.
As a hunter, tracking a cunning pack leader like Sarltooth and taking a claw as a trophy tests marksmanship and beast mastery.
